requirement: Operators shall be able to manage device types and simulations through a web-based management console.

Simulation and device-type management operations shall be available through a regional Amazon API Gateway REST API backed by AWS Lambda. The API shall support cross-origin browser access for the permitted management methods and headers and validate request parameters and bodies.

For route-based simulations, the system shall load JSON route data from the configured Amazon S3 bucket, using the route name supplied in the simulation snapshot or selecting a default route key when none is supplied. Routes shall describe stages with start and end coordinates and distances in kilometres. The simulator shall assemble route state from the loaded route and snapshot information, and report retrieval errors to the caller.
The system shall execute managed device simulations and publish the generated simulated-device messages to AWS IoT topics.
The management API shall provide JSON-formatted access logs, INFO-level method logs, and enabled request tracing to support operational diagnosis.
